body.name: PFullWitness
body.def: \(P_t^{\mathrm F,w}\) is generated by \(X\sim\lambda\), \(A\mid X=x\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(e^{\mathrm w}(x))\), conditionally independent Bernoulli \(Y(0),Y(1)\) with means \(\mu_0^{\mathrm w}(x)\) and \(\mu_0^{\mathrm w}(x)+\tau_t^{\mathrm w}(x)\), and \(Y=AY(1)+(1-A)Y(0)\)
